title: Automatic Sweep: Which Accounts Can Use Automatic Sweeps?
summary: This document explains that Automatic Sweep deposits are supported only for Bronze as a receiving savings destination. It instructs you to designate a Bronze receiving savings account and notes that other account tiers cannot receive sweep deposits. You can change the receiving account anytime for future sweeps.
